adminUi.homeBody: One place for all three apps. Every screen checks with the server who you are; nothing here grants access on its own.
adminUi.sectionColorlabBody: White Balance Shift recipes — Picture Profile and Creative Look, every value within the camera’s limits.
adminUi.sectionWikiBody: Sony cameras, lenses, accessories and audio — specs, features and photographs.
adminUi.sectionBlogBody: Alpha Tech Blogs — write, illustrate, publish and unpublish.
adminUi.notAdminBody: Sign in with an address on the admin list. If yours should be on it, ask an administrator to add it.
adminUi.gateDownBody: The sign-in service is not answering right now. This is not a permissions problem — your access is unchanged. Try again shortly.
adminUi.signInBody: Your email, your password, and the code from your authenticator app. No Google, no redirect.
adminUi.codeBody: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
adminUi.stepUpBody: Your password was accepted. Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
adminUi.signInRefused: That email and password do not match an account.
adminUi.signInNotConfigured: Sign-in is not configured on this deployment.
adminUi.signInUnavailable: The sign-in service is not answering right now. Nothing was changed — try again shortly.
adminUi.codeRefused: That code was not accepted. Codes last about thirty seconds — check your phone’s clock and try the current one.
adminUi.securityBody: The password and the authenticator app that guard the whole admin area. This application stores neither: both live in Supabase Auth on the control project, where they can be revoked without a deploy.
adminUi.passwordBody: Set one here if your account was created by signing in with Google — such an account has no password, and the sign-in form asks for one. At least 12 characters.
adminUi.passwordSet: Password set. Use it the next time you sign in.
adminUi.passwordFailed: The password could not be set. Nothing was changed.
adminUi.totpBody: Add a second factor. Once one is enrolled, a password on its own is no longer enough to reach the admin area — even for someone who steals it.
adminUi.totpActive: A second factor is active. Every admin sign-in asks for a code.
adminUi.scanBody: Scan this with your authenticator app, then type the code it shows to confirm. The code is what proves the app has the secret — nothing is enrolled until you enter one.
adminUi.qrAlt: QR code for enrolling an authenticator app
adminUi.manualEntry: Can’t scan? Enter this key manually
adminUi.enrolDone: Authenticator enrolled. From now on, signing in needs the code.
adminUi.enrolFailed: Enrolment could not be started. Nothing was changed.
adminUi.unenrolConfirm: Remove this authenticator? A password on its own will be enough to reach the admin area again until you enrol another.
adminUi.unenrolFailed: The authenticator could not be removed. Nothing was changed.

recipeAdmin.pickTitle: Pick a recipe, or start a new one
recipeAdmin.pickBody: Every value here is bounded by the camera itself — the form takes its ranges from the same constants the schema and the database CHECK constraints use, so a number this screen accepts is a number a reader can dial in.
recipeAdmin.createNote: The id and the URL are assigned when the recipe is created, and neither can be changed afterwards.
recipeAdmin.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, id, slug or tag
recipeAdmin.name: Name
recipeAdmin.tagsHint: Comma-separated. Lower case and hyphens only — anything else is converted automatically.
recipeAdmin.publishedHint: Unticking this takes it off the site immediately.
recipeAdmin.unpublished: Taken off the site. The recipe and its comments are still here.
recipeAdmin.unpublishConfirm: Take this recipe off the site? Readers will stop seeing it. Nothing is deleted — its comments and photos keep pointing at it, which is why there is no delete here.
recipeAdmin.discardConfirm: Discard the changes you have not saved?
recipeAdmin.wbPresetHint: Custom 1–3 are excluded: they store a white-card reading taken in one particular room, which a reader cannot reproduce.
recipeAdmin.ppSaturationHint: Picture Profile saturation is −32…+32, not the −9…+9 of a Creative Look.
recipeAdmin.monoHint: This Look is monochrome — the camera greys out Saturation, so the field is hidden.
recipeAdmin.clSaturationHint: Creative Look saturation is −9…+9, not the −32…+32 of a Picture Profile.
recipeAdmin.photosHint: Uploads go to a private bucket. Readers are served from public/recipes, which is why a new photograph appears at the next deploy and not before.
recipeAdmin.altPlaceholder: Describe the photograph for a screen reader
recipeAdmin.uploadedPending: Uploaded. You can see it here now; readers will see it after the next deploy.
recipeAdmin.orderPending: New order saved. It reaches the site at the next deploy.
recipeAdmin.removedPending: Removed here. The site keeps showing it until the next deploy.
recipeAdmin.removeLiveConfirm: Remove this photograph? It is on the site now and will stay there until the next deploy — run the vendor command and deploy to finish the job.
recipeAdmin.removePendingConfirm: Remove this photograph? It was never on the site, so nothing changes for readers.
recipeAdmin.pendingBanner: {n, plural, one {# photograph is waiting. To put it on the site, run:} other {# photographs are waiting. To put them on the site, run:}}

lab.feedDescription: Technical articles for Sony Alpha shooters, filtered by topic and skill level.
lab.pinnedTitle: Set up your Sony Alpha in 8 steps
lab.pinnedDek: Eight settings to change before your first shoot, with menu paths for both camera generations and a recap table for quick reference.
lab.emptyBody: No articles match the topic and level you’ve selected. Remove a filter to see more.
lab.firmwareDisclaimer: Menu item names can differ slightly between firmware versions and camera lines. If you can’t find the exact name, look for the closest item in the same group — the value to set is still the one above.
lab.setupTitle: Eight settings to change before you shoot
lab.setupLede: Camera defaults are set for everyone, not for you. The eight settings below make the biggest difference to your results — change them once and you’re done.
lab.recapNoteOld: The paths below follow the old menu (a6400 · ZV-E10). Switch to New menu at the top of the page if your camera uses the new menu.
lab.recapNoteNew: The paths below follow the new menu (a6700 · ZV-E10 II). Switch to Old menu at the top of the page if your camera uses the old menu.

labAdmin.pickTitle: Pick an article, or start a new one
labAdmin.pickBody: Every article is a list of typed blocks — a paragraph, a menu pair, a table, a comparison. There is no free-form body, which is what keeps the contents rail, the checklists and the comparison labels working.
labAdmin.savedWithDropped: Saved. {n, plural, one {# block was} other {# blocks were}} incomplete and not stored.
labAdmin.discardConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
labAdmin.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}” permanently? Its uploaded images are deleted too.

labAdmin.title: Title
labAdmin.slugOnCreate: The URL is generated from the title when you first save.
labAdmin.tldrHint: Exactly three, each a decision or an action
labAdmin.headingHint: A sentence with a verb, never a noun label
labAdmin.tableCaptionHint: State the conditions the table was measured under
labAdmin.calloutLabelHint: The condition it applies under, not the word “note”
labAdmin.compareNeedsBoth: The slider stays hidden until both images are set.
labAdmin.checklistItemsHint: Three to six, each verifiable by eye on the camera
labAdmin.figureCaptionHint: Add information; never re-describe the picture
labAdmin.figureAltHint: What a reader who cannot see it needs to know
